federation.note: The typed EARL (Evaluation And Report Language) RDF data-model for accessibility test results. Turns an axe-shaped scan (framework-neutral, e.g. AccessRadar's ScanResult) into W3C EARL 1.0 + ACT Rules Format 1.1 assertions — one earl:Assertion per (rule x page x failing node x WCAG success criterion), with earl:TestRequirement WCAG-SC IRIs (WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 TR anchors), earl:TestCase axe-rule docs, ptr:CSSSelectorPointer selectors, and earl:automatic mode. Reuses standard vocabulary only (earl:, ptr:, dcterms:, schema:, prov:) — MINTS NOTHING. Typed @rdfjs/wrapper accessors build the graph, n3.Writer serialises it, @jeswr/fetch-rdf parses it back; a SHACL shape pins the assertion contract; an owner-private WAC ACL helper keeps a report pod-private by default. GitHub-installable now (committed dist/, ignore-scripts=true); npm publish is a deferred migration.
